# Admin redirect shell

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../apps/admin)

Preserve old admin bookmarks by redirecting to the storefront operator console.

**Scope:** Retired standalone application, retained as a redirect shell since 2026-05-15.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/admin`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. Only the workspace stub, redirect configuration and retained operational references remain. Current admin implementation is in apps/storefront/src/app/admin.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Put admin features in storefront. Keep redirects and retained references useful; do not recreate a second admin app.
